name: llflash-extension
description: Extension packaging for Llflash Flash emulator

scripts.build: tsc -p jsconfig.json && pnpm run build:generic && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.build:generic: webpack --env generic && tsx tools/inject_plugin_polyfill.ts && tsx tools/zip.ts dist/llflash_extension.zip
scripts.build:webstore: pnpm run build:generic && tsx tools/zip.ts dist/llflash_extension_webstore.zip --strip-key
scripts.build:firefox: webpack --env firefox && tsx tools/inject_plugin_polyfill.ts && tsx tools/zip.ts dist/firefox_unsigned.xpi && pnpm run sign-firefox
